downgrade_R277_rationale: CEO directive R277: 'Do not call it full-build ready yet. First solve: What molecule encodes ICP?' The molecule is UNSPECIFIED. Until a specific molecule is designed and its full 9-step specification path is resolved, P-09 is an ARCHITECTURE/DESIGN CONCEPT, not a buildable prototype.
summary: 0 of 9 specification steps resolved. ALL blocked on step 1 (molecule design). P-09 is ARCHITECTURE_CONCEPT — the architecture is novel and defensible, but the molecule is a medicinal chemistry research question that cannot be answered by code (Article XXXIV).
what_is_ARCHITECTURE_CONCEPT: The architectural idea — chemical molecular signaling for ICP monitoring, zero electronics in brain — is documented and defensible. The implementation path is specified. But no specific molecule exists. This is analogous to having a building design with no building materials selected.
what_is_NOT_ARCHITECTURE_CONCEPT: P-09 is NOT a prototype, NOT a buildable specification, NOT buyer-ready for technical evaluation. A buyer purchasing P-09 today is purchasing a research direction, not a technology package.
what_unfreezes_P-09: A medicinal chemistry research program (12-24 months, $1-5M) to design, synthesize, and test candidate molecules against the 9-step specification. This is research, not engineering.
honest_pricing_implication: P-09 indicative price was $500K+. R277 honest re-assessment: $500K is the price of an architecture + research direction. It is NOT the price of a validated technology package. Buyer must understand they are funding research, not acquiring a product.
constitutional_basis: Article XXV (unknown must remain unknown) — the molecule is genuinely unknown. Article XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion) — cannot promote 'architecture' to 'prototype' without the molecule. Article XXXIV (stop coding when reality is the next bottleneck) — the next bottleneck is medicinal chemistry, not code.
